en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a busy city square with a circular flowerbed and an ornate stone fountain in the foreground. People walk and cycle around the square, and buses are visible on the street. In the background stands a large domed building that was formerly a mosque, fronted by surrounding historic buildings with shops at street level. The reverse side has standard postcard address lines and printed Hungarian text indicating greetings from the city of Pécs.
